desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT/defence community focused on Ukrainian drone strikes damaging Russian oil refineries and fresh US-mediated warnings that current Ukraine peace talks may be the last realistic window before US politics shift. The single most important thread is the reported 45% drop in Russian refining capacity from those attacks.

## MAIN THREADS
### Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil infrastructure
- @wartranslated reported Reuters figures showing 15 of 35 major Russian refineries damaged or offline in November, cutting daily processing from over 700k to ~400k tons. [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2123119524438245479)
- @NOELreports and @sentdefender both highlighted ongoing Ukrainian drone operations targeting energy sites in the same period.

### US-Venezuela military cooperation deal
- @sentdefender detailed the signing of a military-to-military agreement covering cooperation, systems exchanges and intelligence sharing between Secretary Hegseth and Venezuela’s defence minister. [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2123139221628113198)

### Ukraine peace talks and US warnings
- @NOELreports cited Kyiv Independent reporting that US envoys Witkoff and Kushner told negotiators the current talks may be the final realistic chance before Congress changes and aid pressure rises; Moscow still demands all of Donbas. [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2123139075754414179)
- @NOELreports also noted Germany pushing EU budget changes to make future Ukraine funding harder to block by unanimity. [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2123148144938549529)

### US security alerts in Bahrain
- @sentdefender relayed the State Department’s renewed warning for US citizens in Bahrain due to Houthi and Iranian threats. [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2123116963207459041)

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- @Archer83Able: “We got GTA 6 before Russia capturing Donbas.” (unconfirmed) [@Archer83Able](https://x.com/Archer83Able/status/2123140334985028022)
- @NOELreports: Ukraine’s 210th Regiment destroyed concealed artillery, ammo depot, drone and generator in Donetsk. (unconfirmed) [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2123148779780022708)
- @BarakRavid: Naftali Bennett appears to be aligning with Netanyahu on Iran and a possible third war. (unconfirmed) [@BarakRavid](https://x.com/BarakRavid/status/2123140738145825244)

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts are watching whether the reported refinery damage forces Moscow to adjust its Donbas demands or triggers further Ukrainian energy strikes. They are also monitoring any follow-on US-Venezuela military moves and the next round of EU budget negotiations on Ukraine aid.
